brief: Clear the vegetation encroaching on the compound fence within a metre of the radiators, as clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity when a unit is identified for pre-event attention and a vegetation defect is outstanding. Because the unit is an ageing asset with a history of high loading, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure if it cannot be attended before the event. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value and the period.
